title: Windows lost mid-run, and creates that fail at the Dock (issue I7fce35c)
objective: Fix the windows lost mid-run and the creates that fail at the Dock (issue I7fce35c). Its satisfied criteria shipped in 2.15.0, and its open criteria moved to spcz's WP b4300e6f (hv decision 72).
body:
# Windows lost mid-run, and creates that fail at the Dock

cc's work package under the thread's design.md, section 5 (issue I7fce35c, at vc's ask of 23 Nov 2026; ic is second reader). The create's later part waits on M2, and the rest does not.

## The change

- **opt/arngz/lib/plan.lua.**
  - `P.retry_takes(held_world, world)`: a retry from a world whose window filter failed does not replace a plan from a world where it ran.
  - P.plan: with the filter failed, each unseen entry ends with "Hammerspoon's window filter failed (<error>), so windows on desktops not shown could not be named", and carries the fix "run it again; if it fails again, reload Hammerspoon's config (hs.reload() in its console)".
  - P.plan: an app that ran at the start, reads as not running, and still has a start window listed is taken as running (`options.windows_before`, from `P.app_windows`).
  - `P.space_error_kind` names the Dock's Mission Control error `dock`, which stops the tries, and gives its reason and its fix, "add the desktop in Mission Control by hand, then run it again".
  - P.apply_report: the tally's `first_outcome` beside `first`.
- **opt/arngz/lib/arngz.lua.**
  - `retry_unseen` asks `P.retry_takes`, logs a plan that replaces the one in hand, and notes a retry not taken.
  - PHASE.replan sets `windows_before`, and the log says when an app is taken as running.
  - execute passes a report-only op's `fix` to its result.
  - exec_create_space stops on the `dock` kind, with its words and fix, and binds every display for the run, since Mission Control is one for all of them (vc's ruling on 4ce6eec1).
  - Every hold notes its point and the element under it, and whether a web area holds it, before it presses.
- **opt/arngz/lib/log.lua.** finished_fields carries `first_outcome`.
- **ST589246c's progress.md.** The finished row gains `first_outcome`, on cc's word and ic's.
- **toast.lua, ic's, XS.** A partly run's reason line takes its label from the words of the counts, so an unseen `first` reads as not found.
- **help/arngz.md.** What a failed window filter means and its way out, and what a create that fails at the Dock asks of the person.
- **After M2.** If Mission Control's group appeared within 2 s, prepare opens Mission Control itself and looks for its group in later callbacks, for up to 5 s, before a create. If not, nothing more is built.

## Acceptance

AC-322a6511.1 to .9, as design.md's Acceptance gives them. .9 is ic's toast part.

## Tests

- plan_test.lua:
  - `P.retry_takes` in each pairing of a filter that ran and one that failed;
  - P.plan's unseen words and fix with the filter failed;
  - the gone rule with a start window still listed, and with none;
  - `P.space_error_kind`'s `dock` kind, with its words and fix;
  - apply_report's `first_outcome`, and the fix of a report-only result.
- log_test.lua: finished_fields' `first_outcome`, and none for a refusal's or a failed run's words, and the fix from the tally (AC-322a6511.5).
- engine_test.lua, arm 10: the Dock's failure tried once with no sleep, its words and fix, its display bound, and the other display not asked (AC-322a6511.4).
- toast_test.lua, ic's: the reason line's label from the words of the counts, for each of Not found, Failed and Skipped, and the line with no label (AC-322a6511.9).
- The hold's note, and the create's later part if M2 builds it, are read in the bytes and in hv's live run's log.

## Size

S, or M with the create's part after M2.
